data.narrative:
GITAI, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $129M+ to date, is valued here against a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ). The private peer set spans similar stages and includes Hadrian, Nimble Robotics, Exotec, Dexterity, and Bedrock Robotics.

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, implies $219M. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Exotec ($2.0B Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Hadrian ($1.6B Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B Series C)—yields a median of $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce materially different signals. Triangulating both approaches implies a valuation range of $186M to $1.9B, with a median of $935M. The wide dispersion reflects substantial uncertainty around whether GITAI should trade toward earlier-stage fundamentals (stage-progression) or command late-stage peer multiples (peer-median). Key uncertainties include the degree to which GITAI's capital efficiency, technology differentiation, and commercialization trajectory match the sampled peer cohort, particularly those valued at or above $1.6B.
